title: Full Conformal Prediction under Stochastic Non-Conformity Measure
summary: The theory of full conformal prediction uses deterministic non-conformity measure, but modern usage of full conformal prediction often relies on machine learning training, making stochasticity inevitable. A simple sufficient condition of almost sure permutation invariance of the non-conformity measure can be too restrictive, so many have suggested the relaxation to permutation in distribution as a condition for full conformal prediction validity.
